approval.review: Recorded for #246. This approval comes from the pstack interrogate panel under the owner's delegation of 2026-10-15, not from the owner. Changes from the #234 approval: native is upstream's from-source build of 10.12.0, source 928de8ff918488749ca9d23e0a7349873401b7f7, the Linux x86-64 executable 7b3c74db2c4ce06d2b483813a05c6b5928f81b10c471366d677ec25371b52693 carried by its published target image (pinned below), replacing 10.10.0's fd5ffef2d825d9035b3956b0026911a22e2c1b56f7fa205dd00310cfe88aeff5; restic is unchanged; the uniform runtime is Claude Code 2.1.276 through the gateway provider with claude-opus-5-5 at medium effort, replacing Codex 0.155.0 on Node.js v24.21.0 with gpt-5.6-sol, as the adopted environment dotnet-r5 (manifest SHA-256 4f981bdc88b21f5fa12a92add57aa362e8e69aff3d21d778e7c2ef3a20ed2a48) carries it, with the managed settings /etc/claude-code/managed-settings.json (SHA-256 a9e2560ae3194f6bcc4068b1595b981e0f86a69087c2e0fb9cbe75a3053a809f), the only entry in /etc/claude-code, which turn off nonessential traffic and commit and PR attribution, pin effort to medium and output to 32000 tokens, skip WebFetch's preflight, deny WebFetch and WebSearch, and allow no hooks or MCP servers except managed ones, of which the file defines none; the gateway is sub2api at https://gateway.ai.faviann.com, replacing https://cliproxy.local.faviann.com/v1; and native 10.12.0's software-change graph has four executable nodes instead of six. Routing, read from the asset bytes because describe.py does not encode it: deliver runs only when the acceptance and code verdicts are both accepted; any other verdict pair goes to review_retry, and a ci_failed, conflict or repair_required delivery signal goes to delivery_retry; each is a map over the empty continueItems, so it ends the change iteration and the loop continues, and the next iteration runs the one worker node with that phase and its feedback, then both reviews and delivery again, for at most 10 iterations; a crash, malformed, refusal or timeout error of the worker, either review or deliver fails the run. Verified: generate.sh, unchanged from #234 and run with that executable copied out of the pinned image, produces these asset bytes twice in clean environments and native admits them with an exact round trip; describe.py, unchanged, reads the structure below (the worker, acceptance, code and deliver nodes, builtin.git-delivery.pr@2 with the v2/pr receipt (ready, ci_failed, conflict, repair_required) whose non-ready outcomes route to delivery_retry, the 10-iteration change loop, no node deadlines, gateway connections on every agent node, GH_TOKEN only on delivery, and the default consider pull-request feedback); a gateway probe on 2026-10-16 sent the bundled proposer's current request body (max_tokens 12000, reasoning_effort medium, the read_reference tool and the json_object format) and received a read_reference call and then a JSON proposal, and a probe on 2026-10-15 ran Claude Code with --json-schema through the gateway and received structured output; and an offline capture on the published dotnet-r5 image, with no proxy and every DNS query and TLS connection logged, ran native 10.12.0's hosted lane (target serve and a submitted single-worker run that declared only the gateway connection) and Claude Code directly with native's hosted arguments and environment names, both as 20000:10002, against a scripted model that called Bash, Read, Edit, Write, WebFetch and WebSearch, with and without a hostile repository. In it Claude Code contacted only the gateway: one keyless HEAD /api/hello, then every model call at medium effort with max_tokens 32000 and the key as x-api-key. It made no title call, no domain_info request and no web side call, offered neither web tool to any agent or subagent and refused both when called, and Bash, Edit and Write ran. The hostile repository's settings, agent and skill raised neither effort nor tokens and restored neither tool. The second interrogate panel measured on dotnet-r4, whose hook, MCP and attribution settings dotnet-r5 keeps, that a repository's hooks, .mcp.json server and attribution settings did not apply. Approved accepting that the upstream target image is unattested; that no real Claude Code task has yet run through native and sub2api against GitHub, only those probes and that capture against a scripted model; that Claude Code 2.1.276 logs unrecognized_model for claude-opus-5-5; that a target repository's own .claude/settings.json env entries beyond the pinned keys and its apiKeyHelper still apply (#249); that every command an agent runs, including a repository's build and test code and its dependencies, can read the gateway key, to be bounded by a dedicated Broodling gateway key with a quota; and that native acts on pull-request feedback from anyone who can comment on the pull request. Runs are therefore limited to repositories the owner controls whose comments are restricted to collaborators.
